creator: Infinite Arena Studio
inputDescription: Burst mains flood the whole arena shin-deep for the rest of the match
environmentalInteractions: Adds water_present arena-wide for the rest of the match: hydrokinetic reserves recharge everywhere and water-gated abilities unlock for everyone who has them.
The engine slows all grounded fighters without hydro affinity by 35% while they wade; fliers and hover fighters skim above it untouched.
Fire-natured fighters suffer doubly: heat and flame cores drain continuously, and water-triggered environmental weaknesses stay live for the whole match.
sideEffects: Permanent and perfectly symmetric — BOTH teams wade, drain, and unlock in the same water.
Flooding the arena with your own fire fighter drafted is a self-inflicted wound.
There is no way to un-flood: this decision lasts until the final bell.
counterplay: Draft fliers and hover fighters — the flood only punishes those standing in it.
Draft hydro-affinity fighters who move through water unimpeded and feed on the water_present context.
Exploit the symmetry harder than the flooder: if their team wades worse than yours, their wildcard worked for you.
visualManifestation: Hydrant caps blow in sequence and a shin-deep sheet of grey-green water races across the entire arena, wakes trailing behind every moving fighter.
audioManifestation: A rolling crash of arriving water settling into constant splashing underfoot and the drip of soaked structures.
provenance: Curated Season 0 template: global terrain-conversion archetype.
